moments.author: Jacob Coxon
moments.quote: Neither company is acting responsibly—racing straight to self‑improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives.
moments.why: A chilling AI safety resignation that’s gone mega‑viral, triggering debate on existential risk and regulation.

moments.author: Lil Wayne
moments.quote: I literally can’t stop the f— tears rn… may you rest peacefully…
moments.why: A heartfelt tribute from a major figure in culture to Barry Melrose, resonating across sports and hip‑hop fans alike.

moments.author: John Buccigross
moments.quote: Barry gave his life to hockey… I am shook to my core. We love you, Barry. Forever.
moments.why: A deeply emotional homage from Melrose’s longtime ESPN colleague, highlighting his cultural impact on hockey fans.

moments.quote: 49ers TE George Kittle is off the injury report and scheduled to return to play tonight in Australia against the Rams.
